title: Improving neural networks by preventing co-adaptation of feature detectors
summary: Geoffrey E. Hinton, Nitish Srivastava, Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever, and Ruslan R. Salakhutdinov submitted the paper 'Improving neural networks by preventing co-adaptation of feature detectors' on July 3, 2012. The paper describes reducing overfitting by randomly omitting feature detectors during training and refers to the method as random dropout.
significance: A documented research-publication milestone for dropout as a neural-network regularization technique.

verification.note: The original arXiv record identifies the authors, July 3 2012 submission date, and the paper's dropout method. The later JMLR paper independently corroborates the method and authorship. The day-precision date is attached only to the arXiv submission milestone and is not asserted as the method's universal birth date. No geography, institutional affiliation, ancestry, influence, causality or relationships are inferred.
